cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you box our allotment photo, admit that summer wasn't wasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We grew three carrots. I need the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You got out of bed every morning to water those three carrots with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could put the photo on my desk at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you? And tell people that part when they laugh at the harvest.
